content.value: A trapezoidal channel having bottom width 5.0 m and side slopes 1: 1 carries a discharge of 12.0 m<sup>3</sup>/sec. Compute the critical depth and the critical velocity. If Manning's n = 0.2, determine the bottom slope required to maintain the critical depth.
